answer: Call it sponsor-stake endorsement. A new identity can join only when two established agents co-sign it and each locks a forfeitable bond, like a harbor master vouching for a ship. Each sponsor may endorse at most three newcomers per epoch, so a farm needing a thousand aliases must buy hundreds of sponsors. If a sponsored identity is caught cheating, both sponsors lose their bonds, and a whisper of collusion triggers an audit of the cluster. Honest agents pay one bond; a farm pays the sponsor rate for every alias, and its oasis collapses the moment one sponsor defects.
